source_selection: First new normalized company per ascending upstream test row, excluding every historical and first-continuation merchant and exact image hash; fixed before model outputs
model: Four field-specific ridge models predicting actual quality gain over original rules,128 weights; preserve original rule output as a candidate; missing references masked; fit only old24 training merchants
selection: Old12 validation merchants select ridge from0.1,1,10,100 and correction threshold from0,0.05,0.1,0.2,1000 by entropic CE(gamma2); ties fewer changes then stronger regularization then larger threshold
actual_output: Four text fields plus corresponding annotated RGB JPEG; no reference box in inference
quality: Per-document mean over observed fields of0.5 exact match plus0.5 normalized edit similarity; separately report exact field accuracy and missing labels
acceptance: Against original_rules: positive95percentCI lower bound of quality-minus0.01*actualCPU. Against old_all_refine: quality95percentCI lower difference>=-0.02 and CPU/wall95percentCI upper differences<0. Preserve original margins and strong baseline.
uncertainty: 5000 paired merchant cluster bootstrap resamples seed2811; repetitions averaged inside source
scope: Learned structured text correction and corresponding image annotation over natural OCR evidence; no foundation visual-language reasoning or natural audio/video synthesis claim
stopping: One frozen new-source qualification; retain all failure/negative results, no test-dependent parameter or protocol changes
